trial_court: Court of MS Aunradha Jindal, Addl. Senior Civil Judge-Cum-Judge Small Cause Court-Cum-Guardian Judge, District: South, New Delhi
case_name: Sant Kumar vs Shahrukh And Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sant Kumar and Urmila Devi (husband and wife, plaintiffs)
parties.respondent_defendant: Shahrukh and Rahimuddin (son and father, defendants)

facts_of_case: Financial dispute between plaintiffs and defendants; loan sought by defendants due to financial distress; cheques issued but dishonored; suit filed for reimbursement of outstanding amount with interest and damages.

legal_principles.principle: A party who seeks to enforce a claim must establish the existence of a valid loan agreement.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiffs have deliberately withheld the true facts of the case and have failed to provide any documentary proof of disbursing a loan.

legal_principles.principle: A party who is accused of fraud must establish the absence of any deceitful practices.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiffs operate a fraudulent financial scheme through their illegal 'Committee Business', misleading investors and later threatening them with police action when repayment is demanded.

outcome.final_order: The court granted the relief claimed by the plaintiffs, ordering the defendants to reimburse the outstanding amount along with interest and damages.

use_for_drafting: guidelines for filing a civil suit
practical tips for advocates in financial disputes
